title: Keep On Rolling
style: Theatrical 1950s rock and roll, layered unison lead vocals with gang-choir echoes and call-and-response; driving 132 BPM backbeat; brass fanfares, timbales and congas, electric rhythm guitars, upright bass, and drum kit, with shifting verse, pre-chorus, and chorus scenes; tape saturation, plate reverb, stereo delay throws.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The outfit is ready, the mood is right
You have prepared all day for this night
Snacks with your friends, a couple of shots
Nothing will stop you, not words, no thoughts
Bring yourselves to the club, the right place
A time to get loose, a moment to embrace

[Pre-Chorus]
And hit the dancefloor, bring your body
The night is young, and keep on (and keep on)

[Chorus]
Just keep on rolling (rolling, rolling)
Just keep on rolling (rolling, rolling)
Just don't stop, just don't get stuck
(Just don't stop; just don't stop)
Rest is not an option (no option, no option)
Just keep on rolling

[Verse 2]
The right groove with strangers and friends
The right attitude as the music transcends
The bodies and movements of people around
No thinking, just feeling, the beat of sound
Sensuality in the air, no tears, just sweat
And the music going through, no score yet

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold your space, and hold your movement
The night is going, and keep on (and keep on)

[Chorus]
Just keep on rolling (rolling, rolling)
Just keep on rolling (rolling, rolling)
Just don't stop, just don't get stuck
(Just don't stop; just don't stop)
Rest is not an option (no option, no option)
Just keep on rolling

[Bridge]
And movement and rolling (rolling)
The ambient controlling (rolling)
Breathing and sweating (sweating)
In this small setting (sweating)
And movement and rolling (rolling)
The ambient controlling (rolling)
Breathing and sweating (sweating)
In this small setting (sweating)

[Final Chorus]
Just keep on rolling
Just keep on rolling
Just don't stop,
Just don't get stuck
Rest is not an option
Just keep on rolling

[Fade]
Just keep on rolling
